title: Vetting — Attestation — payload
description: A vetter gives an applicant an attestation that names nobody. It carries the same facts a Vetting Statement carries and no issuer: what proves it was made by an eligible vetter is the proof the applicant later builds over it, not a signature on this document.

suite.description: The hidden-vetting suite this attestation was made under, exactly as the community's criterion publishes it. An applicant holding attestations under two suites cannot mix them in one proof.

attestation.description: The attestation itself, multibase base58btc: a tag, a shown class credential and a proof. It carries no identifier of the vetter — the tag is deterministic for this (vetter, applicant) pair and unlinkable across applicants.

meta.description: The facts the community will count. Bound into the attestation, so changing one here invalidates it.

token.description: The attestation token spent for this attestation. The community records the serial, which is how a vetter's rate is capped without anybody learning who they are.

serial.description: The serial revealed by the spend. Recorded by the community; a second appearance is a double spend.

shown.description: The re-randomised token signature, verifiable under the published token key.

Response.title: Vetting Attestation — response payload
Response.description: The applicant's receipt. It verifies the attestation on arrival rather than at submit, so a vetter learns immediately that what it sent is usable.

accepted.description: Whether the attestation verified against the community's published parameters and the card the applicant showed.

heldCount.description: OPTIONAL. How many attestations the applicant now holds for this criterion — a courtesy so a vetter can tell someone they are done.
